name: QuStoch
short: Encodes Brownian-motion stock price paths into qubits so superposition evaluates many market trajectories at once.
full: Encodes Brownian-motion stock price paths into qubits using Hadamard and controlled-rotation gates, letting quantum superposition evaluate many market trajectories in parallel instead of classical Monte Carlo’s sequential sampling. Quantum-generated results are calibrated against historical data and rendered live in a Flask dashboard. Won the Fintech track at HackNYU.
